text_zh: 上海市文旅推广网说明外滩公共滨江步行及建筑外观游览免预约，并列为全年全天开放，没有常规每周闭馆日。本条仅限该公共游览范围；内部场馆、商户、游船、活动及灯光演出按各自安排。临时交通与人流管理可影响通行，行前查现场公告。
text_en: Shanghai’s official culture and tourism promotion site describes public waterfront walking and outdoor architecture viewing on the Bund as not requiring reservations and as open year-round, all day, with no regular weekly closing day. This covers that public sightseeing area only. Indoor venues, shops, cruises, events and lighting shows follow separate arrangements. Temporary crowd or traffic controls may limit access; check on-site notices before visiting.
